newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar AmBisome NDA filing accepted.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar AmBisome NDA filing accepted.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration accepted for review its new drug application for AmBisome.
NeXstar said its application seeks clearance to market the drug for a variety of fungal disease settings.

AmBisome is currently approved for treating systemic, or blood-borne, fungal infections in 25 countries. NeXstar Chief Executive Patrick Mahaffy has said he is hoping for approval this year for AmBisome, which he called "an over $100 million drug" in 1997.
NeXstar's marketing and development partner for the product is Fujisawa USA Inc, a unit of Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, of Osaka, Japan.
